workarounds.symptom: Node bridge: omitting an optional class field in a function argument fails with 'Missing field ... in external Instance'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(engine): accept class arguments that omit nullable fields. Target files: baml_language/crates/bex_engine/src/conversion.rs, baml_language/crates/bex_engine/tests/inbound_omitted_fields.rs. A host that passes a class argument and leaves out a nullable field is rejected, while the same value with that field set to `null` is accepted. From the issue: (Ref: https://github.com/BoundaryML/baml/pull/5291)
